title: Chapter 66 Black Robe Wizard
content:
Chapter 66 Black Robe Wizard

Fortunately, there were no casualties in these 10 seconds.

Baili Liang was the most seriously injured at this time, and his health value had dropped below 200. Wang Shuo quickly ordered him to withdraw from the prison door.

Without Wang Shuo's order, he didn't dare to withdraw!

Originally, his position in this team was quite embarrassing. If he continued to be afraid of death, it would be even more embarrassing in the future.

Soon, Wang Shuo and Ayub regained their ability to move.

"Abu, clear the field!"

Ayub waved his long sword and used a move to sweep away thousands of troops. The skeleton soldiers around the two were immediately repelled, leaving a large space.

Many skeleton soldiers even stumbled directly into other skeleton soldiers, knocking them down.

Wang Shuo rushed directly to the black-robed wizard.

"Dragon Strike" was launched.

Then there was another move "Flame Breath".

These two moves directly took away more than 800 health points of the black-robed wizard.

Ayub also used his ultimate move "Purple Thunder Breaking Sky Strike" again.

"-1200".

Wang Shuo was stunned by this number!

It was like a knife cutting his butt - I opened my eyes.

Abu's Thunder Spear Technique was much more powerful than his Dragon Spear Technique!

Wang Shuo quickly recovered from the shock. The situation was extremely critical at this time, and it was not the time to be stunned.

At this moment, they were still at a disadvantage, and the black-robed wizard's health was still more than half.

"Guliji, come and help us deal with the black-robed wizard." Wang Shuo was a little anxious.

To capture the thief, capture the boss first!

This boss must be killed first.

Guliji "backstabbed" and launched an attack on the black-robed wizard again.

Under the continuous siege of the crowd, the black-robed wizard was also a little angry.

He used the "chaos" skill.

[Chaos: Make the target indistinguishable from friend or foe. ]

Ayub and several others were directly hit and began to fight each other.

The situation was very dangerous.

Ayub slashed at Wang Shuo with a knife.

But Wang Shuo foolishly did not resist and shot Ayub in the back.

Both were injured.

"Lord!" Gong Zheng, who was not hit, saw that Wang Shuo was seriously injured, and immediately rushed over and protected Wang Shuo behind him.

But Wang Shuo, who was in the chaos, ignored his injuries and stabbed Gong Zheng directly. Fortunately, Gong Zheng reacted quickly and was not stabbed.

"They are hit by the "chaos" skill, everyone be careful." Baili Liang, who was standing outside the cell, found the problem and immediately reminded loudly.

"Everyone be careful."

At this moment, Ayub was directly cleared within 2 meters around him. The group attack skill "Sweeping the Thousands of Troops" was maximized in this small environment.

Gong Zheng and Gong Ping directly hugged Wang Shuo and dragged him out of the cell door to prevent him from attacking.

But in this way, only Ayub, Guliji, Gong Kai and the golden armored warriors were left in the cell.

The three people trapped in the encirclement of the skeleton soldiers suddenly felt more pressure.

The defense of the golden armor warrior is very high, and the durability is as high as 5000. Although it is only 1500 now, it should be able to hold on for a while.

The "chaos" lasted for 30 seconds. In these short 30 seconds, everyone's heart was in their throat.

At this time, Wang Shuo's eyes were dull and his mind was in a mess. He only knew that he was eager to kill.

In just 30 seconds, it seemed like he had been sinking in hell for centuries.

The moment he woke up, he was scared and broke out in a cold sweat.

The boss who can cast spells is too scary.

Wang Shuo looked at Ayub, and his health value dropped below 100 at this time.

At the same time, the black-robed wizard began to chant skills again.

"Gong Zheng, hurry! Save Abu!" Wang Shuo shouted hurriedly.

He was afraid that one of his warriors would die.

Fortunately, the black-robed wizard was a little afraid of death and did not dare to attack close.

Even one of his ordinary attacks could kill Ayub.

Gong Zheng heard Wang Shuo's order and flew in front of Ayub.

Fortunately, the time of "chaos" has come, otherwise Gong Zheng will be attacked from both sides.

"Everyone, retreat quickly!" Seeing that everyone was in a bad state, Wang Shuo hurriedly ordered.

Ayub grabbed the imprisoned Gong Zheng and retreated to the prison door.

Guliji and Gong Kai also evacuated quickly.

Baili Liang took the opportunity to lock the prison door.

Until this time, everyone got a chance to breathe.

Wang Shuo was also scared.

The consequences of two people stepping in at the same time were simply terrible!

The skeleton soldiers in the cell kept attacking the iron fence.

But this was destined to be in vain!

"Now, you are finally trapped in a jar!" Wang Shuo said angrily.

Wang Shuo took the lead in taking out the bow and arrow and shot at the black-robed wizard. Although the damage each time was not high, only a few dozen points, it was safe!

Gong Kai also followed Wang Shuo and started shooting.

Others followed suit.

The black-robed wizard had to hide behind the skeleton soldiers.

It was very miserable.

Wang Shuo made up his mind not to take risks easily.

At worst, he could shoot the skeleton soldiers first and then kill the black-robed wizard.

Half an hour later, in the cell, the black-robed wizard finally turned into a pile of bones again.

[You killed the bronze boss black-robed wizard. ]

[Your level has been raised to level 12. ]

After killing the jailer and a large number of undead, Wang Shuo and others accumulated a lot of experience. At this moment, killing the black-robed wizard finally upgraded to another level.

Unfortunately, although the level was upgraded, their status did not recover because of the upgrade.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also found that this kill did not gain all attributes +1.

After this battle, Wang Shuo's cavalry team can be said to have temporarily lost its combat effectiveness.

At the moment, there is no medicine to restore health, which puts Wang Shuo in a dilemma for a while.

"Let's check the spoils first!" Wang Shuo sighed.

Baili Liang opened the prison door and said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, please!"

Wang Shuo felt strange, his subordinates asked him to enter the cell!

However, he did not think much about it. The mage who can summon skills is awesome, and the energy crystals are all over the ground.

There are at least more than 100. When the black-robed wizard became a turtle in the jar, he also summoned several rounds of skeleton soldiers.

Wang Shuo picked them up one by one, and finally came to the place where the black-robed wizard died and picked up the items he dropped.

["Iron Chain Binding" skill book +1, soul crystal +1, energy crystal +30]

Wang Shuo was delighted to see that he had dropped a skill book.

He had suffered a great loss from this skill and knew how powerful it was.

[It was detected that the player had the "Iron Chain Binding" skill book. Do you want to learn it? ]

"Yes."

Wang Shuo clicked on the learning button without hesitation.

Resisting the urge to try it out, Wang Shuo looked at the status of everyone.

The loss of health points basically reached 80%.

He had to find a way to restore his health points, otherwise, his group of people with low health, even a group of ordinary monsters, would be reduced in number.

At this time, Wang Shuo had a flash of inspiration and thought of a way.
